first.rationale: The concurrent declines in onboarding completion and activation make onboarding simplification the most directly evidenced lever for restoring early adoption and supporting sustainable qualified revenue. I will verify both prior source records before committing, since they describe related but distinct signup/onboarding interventions and should clarify the transferable mechanism and target segment. Promotional pricing is relevant to the competitor threat, but its inherited evidence has a pooled-cohort caveat and discounting may be less durable.
